basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old digital marketing student from Leeds, UK. I've recently joined Reddit to connect with communities that share my interest in online gaming and content creation. I enjoy watching YouTube videos, especially from the Sidemen and other gaming groups. I'm a night owl, usually online from 10 PM to 2 AM GMT. Single and focusing on my studies, I often take breaks by diving into gaming or watching new series. I have a part-time job at a local cafe which helps fund my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a decent understanding of digital marketing principles from my university courses. I'm also self-taught in video editing, picking up skills through online tutorials and trial-and-error while creating content for my small YouTube channel. I'm familiar with the latest trends in online gaming, particularly those involving popular content creators.
